name: archive.tar
doc:
tar archives (POSIX.1-2001 ustar/pax, GNU long names and base-256
numbers on read): reading and writing in memory. Long or non-ASCII
names, big sizes and big ids are written as pax extended headers.
ExtractTo / FromDir move archives to and from directories (regular
files and directories; links are listed but not created).

items.name: TypeDir
items.doc: Type flag of a tar header (regular file, hard link, symlink, directory).
items.summary: Type flag of a tar header (regular file, hard link, symlink, directory).

items.summary: Type flag of a tar header (regular file, hard link, symlink, directory).

items.summary: Type flag of a tar header (regular file, hard link, symlink, directory).

items.name: ExtractTo
items.doc:
Extracts the regular files and directories of the archive under dir;
names that would escape dir are an error, other entry types are skipped.
items.summary: Extracts the regular files and directories of the archive under dir; names that would escape dir are an error, other entry types are skipped.

items.name: FromDir
items.doc: Archives the files under dir (recursively, names relative to dir).
items.summary: Archives the files under dir (recursively, names relative to dir).

items.name: Read
items.doc: Reads every entry of an archive.
items.summary: Reads every entry of an archive.

items.name: Entry
items.doc: An entry: its header and content.
items.summary: An entry: its header and content.

items.name: Reader
items.doc: Sequential access to the entries of an archive in memory.
items.summary: Sequential access to the entries of an archive in memory.

members.name: Next
members.doc: The next entry's header, or nil at the end of the archive.
members.summary: The next entry's header, or nil at the end of the archive.

members.name: Data
members.doc: The content of the entry returned by the last Next.
members.summary: The content of the entry returned by the last Next.

items.name: Writer
items.doc: Builds an archive in memory: Add entries, then Close() returns the bytes.
items.summary: Builds an archive in memory: Add entries, then Close() returns the bytes.
